interview.name: Ira
interview.answer: The repair drive is still tentative, and no exact time or meeting spot has been confirmed yet.

reflections: Vik is taking a coordinating role and proactively keeping others updated on the repair drive.
Ira is supportive and responsive, offering help and handling follow-up communication with Bo.
Bo is engaged but prefers concise, essential information rather than a detailed back-and-forth.
Ira is coordinating the repair drive and tends to reply with short, reassuring commitments while deferring specifics until back from errands.
Bo and Mina both want practical details before they can proceed, while Opal is helping track coverage and fill gaps.
The group is coordinating around a shared repair-drive effort, with people asking for essentials, timing, and uncovered houses so the work can be organized.
Ira is coordinating a repair drive and repeatedly promises to send essentials once back from errands, suggesting they are the organizer and currently time-constrained.
Mina is trying to confirm timing and needed basics, which shows she is engaged but needs clearer coordination from Ira.
Dane and Oren are supportive and ready to help with the next fix, indicating the group is cooperative and responsive once details are shared.
Ira is the central coordinator, repeatedly promising to send repair-drive basics, timing, and meeting details once back from errands.
Hana is managing the plan cautiously and wants concrete confirmation before treating the repair drive as firm.
Oren and Nell are supportive participants who are waiting for Ira’s update and are ready to help with tools and equipment.
Ira is responsive and keeps others updated, but only after finishing errands and with just the essentials.
Bo, Nell, and Leo are coordinating around the repair drive by asking for the basics and offering to keep things moving.
The group prefers tentative, practical coordination: waiting for confirmation on timing and location, then sharing concrete repair details.
